ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan a receive QR code shown on another screen, or take a photo to send in a chat. The camera opens only when you tap Take Photo or scan; when scanning, Tapiro reads the code only.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a picture to send in a chat, attach as payment or receipt proof, read a receive QR code from a screenshot, or show Tapir a screenshot. Tapiro only gets the pictures you pick.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save a payee's receive QR code to Photos so you can scan it from your wallet app. Tapiro only adds this one image.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sort nearby bounties and rides by how far they are, show nearby places first when you search, or use where you are now as a bounty's or ride's place. Used only while you use Tapiro.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Records your voice when you talk to Tapir, to turn it into text in the field. Recording starts only when you tap the microphone and ends when you tap stop.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Turns what you say to Tapir into text. Your phone recognises it first; if it can’t, and you have agreed, the recording goes to Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Singapore).
